issues.summary: The pinned upstream commit has no requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.py, environment.yml, Pipfile, poetry.lock or uv.lock, so every dependency version remains unresolved.
No .pth, .pt, .ckpt, .bin or .safetensors checkpoint is present at the pinned commit; no router checkpoint identity or digest can be frozen.
The README documents python experiments/run_mbpp.py, but the repository path is Experiments/run_mbpp.py; the case mismatch fails on case-sensitive filesystems.

Experiments/run_mmlu.py imports Datasets.MMLU.download, but no Datasets/MMLU/download.py exists at the pinned commit, so run_mmlu.py fails at import time even though the download call is commented out.

Dataset paths mix Datasets and datasets casing (README and run scripts use Datasets, Datasets/mmlu_dataset.py uses datasets/MMLU), and run_gsm8k.py defines a lowercase default while hard-coding a capital-D path.
claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 is priced at 1.0/5.0 USD per million tokens in llm_profile.py but 0.8/4.0 in price.py; the conflict is unresolved and cost claims are disabled.

GSM8K and HumanEval call fix_random_seed(1234), which seeds torch only; split_list and MbppDataLoader use Python random.shuffle without random.seed, so the declared 20/80 split is not reproducible across processes.
MBPP is loaded through pandas from hf://datasets/google-research-datasets/mbpp without a pinned dataset revision, file digest or record count.

The paper evaluates a stratified 519-problem MATH subset; sample_MATH.py uses hard-coded absolute paths, unsorted directory order and 10 percent per level, and emits no subset ID manifest, so the exact paper subset cannot be reconstructed from the repository.

run_mmlu.py caps training at 40 batches and then skips the first train_batch batches of the test split, so the evaluated test slice depends implicitly on the dev split size and is not stated as a dataset lock.

template.env and the README document URL and KEY, but gpt_chat.py also reads BASE_URL, API_KEY, DS_URL, DS_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL and OPENROUTER_API_KEY; provider selection and required variables are not documented.

LLMRegistry.get selects the Deepseek client only when the model name contains the case-sensitive substring DeepSeek-V3; source profile deepseek-chat and paper name deepseek-v3 both fall through to ALLChat, so the DS_URL/DS_KEY path is effectively unreachable for the recorded pools.
The paper pool and source pool are recorded separately, but no provider, provider model revision or region is frozen for any model.
No Python version is declared upstream; PEP 604 syntax such as str | None in agent.py implies a 3.10 minimum, but no exact interpreter version or artifact digest is locked.
price.py always tokenizes with the gpt-4o encoding regardless of the model being costed, so token counts and cost accounting are not model-specific.
None of the five benchmark datasets has a frozen byte size, SHA-256 or record count at T51; execution remains blocked until each dataset is downloaded in an isolated environment and locked.

Two GSM8K processing modules exist (Datasets/gsm8k_dataset.py and Datasets/gsm8k/gsm8k_dataset.py); run_gsm8k.py imports the top-level module, so the nested copy is ambiguous dead code for this entrypoint.
